items.title: US Spot Bitcoin ETF Daily Net Flows ($ millions)
items.description: Daily net flows into US spot bitcoin ETFs in $ millions, late July to Nov 20, 2026. Outflows dominate November, with the largest red bars near -$600M+ around Nov 19–20.
items.reason: US spot bitcoin ETFs just logged a record $1.64B weekly outflow with BTC near $60K.

items.title: MSTR Market Cap vs. BTC Reserve Value
items.description: Strategy's market cap vs the value of its bitcoin by quarter, with the ratio line. It was 0.64x on 11/23/26, down from 1.77x in mid-2025.
items.reason: MSTR is trading below the value of its bitcoin, and JPMorgan called it a sign of capitulation.

items.title: Tesla vs the rest of the Magnificent 7 since end-2022 (rebased to 100)
items.description: Tesla vs the equal-weight average of the other Magnificent 7 and the Nasdaq-100, rebased to 100 at end-2022.
items.reason: TSLA closed at exactly $400 on Nov 27 after a 5% jump amid SpaceX merger talk.

items.title: Starlink subscribers (millions): 2.3m at end-2023, 12.0m by June 2026
items.description: Starlink subscribers in millions: 2.3m at end-2023, rising to 12.0m by June 2026.
items.reason: SpaceX is in the headlines with Musk's SpaceX-share pledge to American kids and orbital AI data center talk.

items.title: Nvidia's market value ($5.6tn) vs annual GDP of the largest economies (2025, excluding the US)
items.description: Nvidia's market value ($5.6tn as of Oct 2, 2026) vs the 2025 GDP of the largest economies outside the US; only China's is larger.
items.reason: Nvidia is in the news for halting AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries, as AI stocks led a $1T Black Friday rally.
